degenerateReason: aOptionalString is omitted when NULL, so a parent leaf is either a set string (== null is false) or missing (an error), and a missing parent is an error too: no row can be allowed. The empty oracle still fails any translation that returns a row; relation/or/one-hop-null-literal-or-root-attribute carries the discriminating oracle.
intent: parent.aOptionalString == null through the to-one parent.
trap: A two-valued IS NULL over a LEFT JOIN returns a4/a7/c1 (NULL leaf) and every parentless row, all of which CEL denies as a missing attribute.
